name: 33618 · Tampa, FL
findings: ZIP 33618 (Tampa) has 145 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33618 (Tampa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
